sn35.110:1.1: Near Sāvatthī. There the Blessed One said, “Monks, I will teach you clingable phenomena & clinging.
sn35.110:1.2: Listen & pay close attention. I will speak.”
sn35.110:1.3: “As you say, lord,” the monks responded to him. The Blessed One said, “And which, monks, are clingable phenomena? Which is the clinging?
sn35.110:1.5: Whatever desire-passion is there, that is the clinging there. “The ear is a clingable phenomenon. Whatever desire-passion is there, that is the clinging there. “The nose is a clingable phenomenon. Whatever desire-passion is there, that is the clinging there. “The tongue is a clingable phenomenon. Whatever desire-passion is there, that is the clinging there.
sn35.110:1.6: “The body is a clingable phenomenon. Whatever desire-passion is there, that is the clinging there.
sn35.110:1.8: Whatever desire-passion is there, that is the clinging there.
sn35.110:1.9: “These are called clingable phenomena. This is the clinging.”
